command.help.base:
Aquahunger commands

/aquahunger - Show this help message.
command.help.set.self: /aquahunger set <hungerLevel> - Set your own hunger level (0-100).
command.help.set.other: /aquahunger set <player> <hungerLevel> - Set another player's hunger level (0-100).
command.help.stats: /aquahunger stats - Show server records (Most Gluttonous, etc).
command.help.hide: /aquahunger hide - Hide your hunger and thirst bars.
command.help.show: /aquahunger show - Show your hunger and thirst bars again.
command.help.integrations: /aquahunger integrations - Show which RPG and skill mods are connected.
command.hud.hidden: Hunger and thirst bars hidden. Use /aquahunger show to bring them back.
command.thirst.help.base:
Thirst commands

/aquathirst - Show this help message.
command.thirst.help.set.self: /aquathirst set <thirstLevel> - Set your own thirst level (0-100).
command.thirst.help.set.other: /aquathirst set <player> <thirstLevel> - Set another player's thirst level (0-100).
